scenarios.name: add
scenarios.description: Stage modified files vs git add -A

commands.git:
set -eu
if [ -s /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/.grit-bench-worktree-paths ]; then
  tr '\n' '\0' < /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/.grit-bench-worktree-paths | xargs -0 git add -- > /dev/null 2>&1
fi

set -eu
if [ -s /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/.grit-bench-worktree-paths ]; then
  tr '\n' '\0' < /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-synth-10k/.grit-bench-worktree-paths | xargs -0 grit add -- > /dev/null 2>&1
fi
